scope: 48 checkpoint shards/node on four nodes; no runtime configuration changes; serving stopped

method.checksums: SHA256 via aligned O_DIRECT before and after each shard; cross-node hash agreement check after the run
method.defragmenter: e4defrag -v on resolved individual checkpoint blobs

serving: stopped for the window (cluster stop --apply); restored by window close
conclusion: 8 GiB limit fixed the 10-02 OOM; full pass completed with data intact, but e4defrag only corrected shards with a nearby large free run: the heavily fragmented 7 GiB and 101 GiB shards did not move. Fleet extents -4.4%; no measurable boot benefit expected. Lever closed; a copy-rewrite would be a different operation.
